content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the HBCHRC Visakhapatnam Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download HBCHRC Visakhapatnam Technician (Transfusion Medicine) Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Technician (Transfusion Medicine): Diploma in DMLT or Transfusion Medicine or Blood Bank Technology after 10+2, Degree in M.L.T. or Blood Bank Technology, B.Sc. in Hematology and Transfusion Medicine, M.Sc. in Transfusion Medicine, or P.G.D in M.L.T. Candidates must possess one-year experience for Diploma holders and six months experience for Degree/B.Sc./M.Sc./P.G.D holders in the testing of blood and/or its components in licensed Blood Centre (post-qualification only).

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Technician (Transfusion Medicine): Maximum age is 35 years.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for HBCHRC Visakhapatnam Technician (Transfusion Medicine) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre, Aganampudi, Visakhapatnam for temporary positions in the healthcare sector.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post available in this notification?
faq.answer: The available post is Technician (Transfusion Medicine) under the Transfusion Medicine department.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are announced for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Technician (Transfusion Medicine) position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the monthly salary for the Technician post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Technician (Transfusion Medicine) position will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 24,260.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process is entirely based on a walk-in interview conducted directly at the designated centre in Visakhapatnam.

faq.question: Q6. What is the date of the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 8 December 2026 at the specified venue in Visakhapatnam.

faq.question: Q7. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Technician (Transfusion Medicine) post is 35 years as specified in the recruitment advertisement.

faq.question: Q8. What educational qualifications are required?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Diploma in DMLT, Transfusion Medicine, or Blood Bank Technology, or a relevant Degree/B.Sc./M.Sc./P.G.D in allied medical laboratory technologies with mandatory post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q9. Where should candidates report for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must report in person to the HRD Department, First Floor, Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital Research Centre, Visakhapatnam along with all mandatory documents.

faq.question: Q10. What documents must be brought to the interview?
faq.answer: Applicants must carry an updated resume, passport size photograph, PAN card, Aadhar card, and original certificates along with one set of self-attested photocopies.
